A full drive crawls no matter how new the PC is.

posts.title: Set up proper battery care

slides.text:
Set up proper battery care
Cap charge at 80% if your vendor offers it
Cap charge at 80% if your vendor offers it
Avoid leaving it at 100% for weeks on end
Occasional deep discharge is fine, not daily
Keep firmware and battery drivers updated
A battery at 80% capacity after 2 years is normal.
